<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" viewBox="0 0 100 150" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" width="100%" height="100%"><rect id="svgEditorBackground" x="0" y="0" width="100" height="150" style="fill:none;stroke:none;"/>
    <style>
    .pres { font: bold 16px sans-serif; fill:white }
    .temp { font: italic 16px sans-serif; fill:white }
    tspan { font: italic 16px sans-serif; fill:white }
    </style>
    
    <!-- toad outline -->
    <rect x="23" y="16" width="60" height="120" rx="15" stroke="white" fill="#515151"/>

    <!-- T1 outline-->
    <rect id="T1" x="73" y="36" width="10" height="30" rx="3" stroke="white" fill="#008000"/>
    <!-- T2 outline-->
    <rect id="T2" x="23" y="36" width="10" height="30" rx="3" stroke="white" fill="#008000"/>
    <!-- T3 outline-->
    <rect id="T3" x="73" y="86" width="10" height="30" rx="3" stroke="white" fill="#008000"/>
    <!-- T4 outline-->
    <rect id="T4" x="23" y="86" width="10" height="30" rx="3" stroke="white" fill="#008000"/>

    <!-- T1 Value -->
    <text id="T1_pres" x="110" y="47" class="pres" text-anchor="end">99</text>
    <text id="T1_temp" x="116" y="67" class="temp" text-anchor="end">99<tspan>°</tspan></text>

    <!-- T2 Value -->
    <text id="T2_pres" x="11" y="47" class="pres" text-anchor="end">99</text>
    <text id="T2_temp" x="16" y="67" class="temp" text-anchor="end">99<tspan>°</tspan></text>

    <!-- T3 Value -->
    <text id="T3_pres" x="110" y="97" class="pres" text-anchor="end">99</text>
    <text id="T3_temp" x="116" y="117" class="temp" text-anchor="end">99<tspan>°</tspan></text>
    
    <!-- T4 Value -->
    <text id="T4_pres" x="11" y="97" class="pres" text-anchor="end">99</text>
    <text id="T4_temp" x="16" y="117" class="temp" text-anchor="end">99<tspan>°</tspan></text>

    
</svg>
